name: Market Creators Limited
about: Market Creators Limited engages in broking business in India. The company provides advice-based broking in equities and derivatives, depository, commodities trading, portfolio management, mutual fund investment advisory, IPO, insurance, and real estate management services, as well as merchant banking and e-broking services. It trades and invests in equities; and trades in and distributes financial products. Market Creators Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Vadodara, India.
